strict_completion: both required legs prove exactly five contracts filled from private exchange receipts, with a non-null exchange placement clock for every filled order, non-null exchange fill and completion clocks, and completion no later than an exact-start or clean-interval safe pre-start cutoff
non_window1_fill: a filled leg with a non-null completion exchange clock at or after an official-provider or public-exchange-tape known-live-by upper bound, or after an exact/clean safe pre-start cutoff; a local receipt bound cannot prove this ruling
reference: last positive-size exchange-identified true print for the leg at or before its exact or clean-interval safe pre-start cutoff
leg_delta: actual exact-five fill VWAP minus leg Window-1-close reference
combined_delta: sum of the two individual leg deltas
combined_cost_under_par: sum of exact-five leg VWAPs strictly below 100 cents
both_individual_negative: both individual leg deltas are strictly negative
one_leg_only_negative: exactly one individual leg delta is strictly negative
dynamic_floor: sum over both legs of Window-1 close minus edge_p50(category, integer close-price cell) from recut_cells.json
dynamic_floor_gap: combined entry cost minus dynamic floor

per_leg_dip_catch.fitted_target: Window-1 close minus edge_p50(category, integer close-price cell)
per_leg_dip_catch.gap: leg fill VWAP minus fitted target

bounds.optimistic_upper_bound: observed primary successes plus every event whose two leg lifecycle upper bounds still permit exact-five success and whose primary ruling remains evidentially unresolved

censor_law: censored events remain in D and never count as observed successes
